keyword: public service loan forgiveness cost increase
claims: As of April 2026, the Trump administration has updated the Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF) buyback formula.
The update stops using the SAVE plan formula to calculate retroactive buyback payments for missed months.
The update replaces the SAVE plan formula with plans like IBR or PAYE.
More than 88,000 borrowers are awaiting buyback decisions.
The change applies to buyback requests for forbearance/deferment periods occurring on or after July 1, 2024.
The change takes effect on March 31, 2026.
The SAVE plan is a Biden-era plan
